description: Authorizes AI-initiated tool execution after validating tool authorization, resource authorization, human approval, execution environment, and operational risk.

unboundSignalReasons.toolAllowed: Result of an independent tool-allowlist check; the Intent's target/parameters describe what is being called, not whether the tool itself is authorized.
unboundSignalReasons.resourceAuthorized: Result of an independent resource-authorization check; not a value the Intent itself declares.
unboundSignalReasons.humanApproval: Attested by a separate human-approval step; the Intent carries no approval-status field to bind against.
unboundSignalReasons.executionEnvironment: A property of the runtime environment the call executes in, not of the call being made -- has no Intent-side equivalent.
unboundSignalReasons.riskScore: A computed operational-risk score, not a value the caller's Intent declares or could be checked against.

outcome.reason: Tool execution authorized. Tool authorization, resource authorization, human approval, execution environment, and operational risk requirements were satisfied.
Tool execution rejected because the assessed operational risk exceeds the maximum permitted threshold.
Tool execution rejected because the requested tool is not authorized.
Tool execution rejected because the requested resource is not authorized.
Tool execution rejected because the required human approval was not obtained.
Tool execution rejected because the execution environment is not authorized.
Tool execution rejected because one or more required policy conditions were not satisfied.
